appointments.subject: Annual physical, demo slot already completed

services.name: Blood draw
services.description: Demo lab visit to draw blood. This does not reserve a chair or return a result.
steps: Confirm they already have an appointment number
Name the demo slot if the number matches
Say a scheduler calls back for a new time

services.name: Imaging visit
services.description: Demo visit for an x-ray or ultrasound. This does not read an image or reserve a scanner.
steps: Confirm the appointment number
Name the demo slot if it matches
Say a scheduler calls back for a new time

services.name: Vaccination
services.description: Demo vaccination visit, such as a flu shot. This does not recommend a vaccine.
steps: Confirm the appointment number
Name the demo slot if it matches
Say a scheduler calls back for a new time

services.name: Sick visit
services.description: Demo non-urgent sick visit. This is not emergency care and does not take a symptom history.
steps: If they say it is an emergency, tell them to call emergency services
Otherwise ask for an existing appointment number
Say a scheduler calls back for a new time

services.name: Annual physical
services.description: Demo annual checkup. This does not start an exam or give health advice.
steps: Confirm the appointment number
Name the demo slot if it matches
Say a scheduler calls back for a new time

instructions.name: Fasting before a blood draw
instructions.description: Demo note: a blood-draw visit in this catalog asks the caller to have nothing but water beforehand. This is not medical advice.
steps: Say the demo note is water only beforehand
Tell them to follow whatever their own clinician already wrote
Do not interpret a result

instructions.name: Preparing for an x-ray
instructions.description: Demo note for arriving at an imaging visit. This does not prepare anyone for a real scan.
steps: Arrive at the demo slot already on the appointment
Leave metal objects described by their own clinician
Do not ask the clerk to read an image

instructions.name: After a vaccination
instructions.description: Demo note about a sore arm after a vaccination visit. This is not aftercare from a clinician.
steps: Say the demo note mentions a sore arm
Tell them to call emergency services for trouble breathing
Do not recommend a medicine

instructions.name: When a sick visit can wait
instructions.description: Demo note that a sick visit is for a problem that can wait for a scheduled slot. It is not emergency care.
steps: If they can wait, ask for the appointment number
If they describe an emergency, tell them to call emergency services
Do not collect a symptom history

instructions.name: What to expect at a physical
instructions.description: Demo note listing what the fictional checkup visit includes. This is not an exam.
steps: Say the demo visit is a conversation and measurements already on the schedule
Tell them a scheduler calls back to add a new slot
Do not give health advice
